delete.title: Delete schedule?
delete.text: Delete “{{name}}”? Scheduled deliveries will stop immediately.

cadence.monthlyLastDay: Monthly on the last day at {{time}}

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Descriptive name for this scheduled delivery, up to 120 characters.
form.targetTypeHint: Choose whether this schedule delivers a dashboard or a report. It cannot be changed after creation.
form.targetHint: Choose the dashboard or report to run on each occurrence. It cannot be changed after creation.
form.periodHint: Reporting time window evaluated on each scheduled run.
form.weekdayHint: Day of the week when weekly deliveries run.
form.monthDayHint: Calendar day (1–28) or the last day of each month.
form.timeZoneHint: Time zone used to evaluate the run schedule and period.
form.languageHint: Language used for generated links and attached files.
form.startsOnHint: First date on which this schedule can run.
form.endsOnHint: Optional last date on which this schedule can run.
form.linkTtlHoursHint: Hours before delivery links expire (1–720, or up to 168 with attachments).
form.recipientsHint: Select 1 to 50 users who will receive this delivery.
form.channelHint: Deliveries are sent by email to each recipient. Email is the only delivery channel in this release.
form.attachmentsHint: Optional file formats attached to each run. PDF is not available yet.

discard.title: Save changes?
discard.text: You have unsaved changes on this schedule.

validation.NAME_TOO_LONG: Name must be 120 characters or fewer.
validation.ENDS_BEFORE_STARTS: End date cannot be before start date.
validation.TTL_OUT_OF_RANGE: Enter a whole number between 1 and 720.
validation.TTL_ATTACHMENT_LIMIT: Link validity cannot exceed 168 hours when attachments are enabled.
